description: Payments under €$100 (€$0.01 steps) are readings on a meter, backed by whole €$100 units this AI parks — a 0h unit backs €$100, a 42 its euro worth (about €$8,000). status: the meter; park: set units aside for small payments; unpark: take unspent units back.

units.description: How many €$100 units (1–100) to park or unpark.

window.description: park only: 0 or 42 — which funds to park. Default: oldest first.
